title: What’s Next for NetEase, Inc. (NTES) After Forming Double Bottom?
text:
What’s Next for NetEase, Inc. (NTES) After Forming Double Bottom? Posted by Winifred Garcia 14 pm
The chart of NetEase, Inc. (NTES) shows a double bottom with $221.67 target or 6.00 % below today’s $235.82 share price. The 7 months chart pattern indicates high risk for the $30.97B company. It was reported on Dec, 21 by Finviz.com . If the $221.67 price target is reached, the company will be worth $1.86 billion less. Double bottoms are rare but powerful chart patterns.
The stock increased 1.05% or $2.45 during the last trading session, reaching $235.82. About 5,390 shares traded. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has declined 26.07% since December 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.07% the S&P500.
Analysts await NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) to report earnings on February, 6. They expect $2.36 earnings per share, up 58.39 % or $0.87 from last year’s $1.49 per share. NTES’s profit will be $309.94 million for 24.98 P/E if the $2.36 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.80 actual earnings per share reported by NetEase, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 31.11 % EPS growth. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) Ratings Coverage
